I had an abortion in my twenties . I was on my period when the child was conceived and missed a couple of birth control pills . I didn’t think I would get pregnant but I did . I did not want to be a mother . I am forever grateful I had the option .
I was spotting heavily and initially thought I was menstruating . The doctor told me the fetus did not have a heartbeat so my body was attempting to miscarry . I had felt ill , weak and out of breath. The doctor advised me it was dangerous to remain pregnant and eventually I would miscarry . I decided to have an abortion . I would have decided to have an abortion even it was a healthy pregnancy . I would not be able to choose an abortion in some states now despite the danger to me of a miscarriage during late pregnancy and even though there was no heartbeat . I was so sick I had to stop every twenty feet and I was terrified. I can only imagine being forced to carry to term getting sicker and weaker because a doctor would not give me an abortion . I can hear people saying , you could give up your child for adoption . I was adopted at birth . Being adopted is traumatic for a child and for the birthparent(s) . The effects are long lasting . Not for everybody but it’s not akin to re homing a puppy . I’m not asking anyone to have an abortion . I’m asking you and the government not to meddle with my decisions
